description: This PHP class 'LocationService' provides various methods for managing location data within an HRM system, including retrieval, search, normalization, and deletion of locations, as well as fetching associated employee counts and IDs.

classes.name: LocationService
classes.description: A service class that manages location data including CRUD operations, searches, and associated employee information within the HRM system.

methods.name: getLocationDao
methods.description: Retrieves an instance of LocationDao, initializing it if not already set.

methods.name: setLocationDao
methods.description: Sets the LocationDao instance used by this service.

methods.name: getLocationById
methods.description: Fetches a Location entity by its ID.

methods.name: searchLocations
methods.description: Searches for locations based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getSearchLocationListCount
methods.description: Returns the count of locations matching filter parameters.

methods.name: getNumberOfEmployeesForLocation
methods.description: Counts the number of employees assigned to a specific location.

methods.name: getLocationIdsForEmployees
methods.description: Retrieves location IDs for a list of employee numbers.

methods.name: getAccessibleLocationsArray
methods.description: Returns an array of locations accessible to a specific employee or all if null.

methods.name: saveLocation
methods.description: Saves a Location entity to the database.

methods.name: getLocationsArray
methods.description: Returns an array of all locations, normalized for output.
